productName: Medium Women's Chemo Care Package
author: Christine M.
title: Cut out the middle man.
message: The idea is great in theory. I could have saved a lot of money collecting items and shipping this myself. The website glitched on me in two ways. First, it would not let me put the credit card date in because it would not accept the characters, but also would not approve the card without them. Second, although I entered the “ shipped to “ address on the website, they claim I put my billing address in as the shipping address. I clearly remember looking her address up and painstakingly typing it in the website. When I received the box in the mail erroneously, I was surprised that the box was so small for a medium selection. I contacted the company, and their advice to the error and sending it to me was that I pay shipping and send it back to them and then they would send it to the correct address. I told him them not to worry about it that I would send it directly to her because that would be insanity. If I was going to pay for shipping, why would I not just send it to her? This would’ve been less painstaking for me to just have done the shopping to begin with and box it up and send it. For me to ship it with half the shipping charge that they charged me.
replyMessage: Christine, Thank you for taking the time to share your experience. I’m truly sorry for the frustration you encountered — that’s never the experience we want for anyone who orders from Rock the Treatment. As you are aware, the shipping label was generated with the address that was entered on your order. We understand how online forms can sometimes feel confusing, and we always do our best to assist when something goes wrong, regardless of the source of the error. When you reached out to us, you requested that we reship the package to the intended recipient. We agreed to take the package back and resend it at no additional cost, even though the address had been entered incorrectly at checkout. You later chose to forward the package directly yourself instead, which we completely understood. We also appreciate your feedback about the website. As mentioned in our immediate response to your issue, our IT team did research the issue and was not able to identify any system errors, nor have other customers reported similar technical problems. Regarding the size of the medium box, our care packages are intentionally curated in a compact, protective shipping box to ensure the items arrive safely and neatly arranged. Again, I’m very sorry your experience didn’t meet your expectations. We value every customer and will continue working to make the ordering and gifting process as seamless and supportive as possible.

author: Lori Lee
message: As a recently diagnosed breast cancer patient, my treatment and surgical research began which included, necessities and preparations for what was to come. I wanted to be as well prepared as possible to ease and aid recovery. In addition, as I would be traveling from Northern Nevada to MDAnderson Cancer Center in Houston Texas for my procedures and treatment, it was vital that I had what I could, in hand before arrival. With the likelihood of post mastectomy / lumpectomy drains etc for a period of time and staying in a hotel near the hospital, I will be anxious to “comfortably” fly back home as soon as possible. I was able to have a wonderful conversation with owner Stacy Berk who offered numerous suggestions (ie ask flight attendants on the longer routes to cool or freeze extra ice packs to switch out) and insights as well as needed and deeply appreciated moral support. To start, I purchased the RTT Breast Cancer Mastectomy Pillow with ice packs. It arrived quickly and will no doubt aid with the initial post surgery discomforts and help protect my suture areas when in a car wearing seat belts or in flight. It will also help “cover” any loosely fitting clothing to accommodate dressings or drains if out in public. I won’t be carrying a strapped purse etc either so the extra pockets for my phone, glasses, and billfold are ideal. time before being able to fly back home. I will learn more next week as to any needed radiation and / chemo followup. If so, I will no doubt be calling Stacy at “Rock the Treatment” for more skin care or other specific products to help get me through! No matter what, I now have a connection and place to go for gifting others living with and surviving cancers with special care products! We all need that “Lift me up Spirit” right??? Well, Stacy sure gifted me with that and more! I will be happy to update my post surgery experience and travels in the coming weeks. In the interim, THANK YOU again Stacy for your personal care and attention as I begin this new cancer journey. It’s a time with heightened stress and anxiety and you helped set me more at ease. We will chat again very soon! Sincerely, Lori Lee
replyMessage: Lori, To take the time with all you have going on you are an extraordinary person!! It was my privilege to help resolve some of the logistical issue you will have to navigate. (We are will be writing a blog as to help other #CancerWarriors that will have the same issue. Thank you so much for taking the time to sharing. Your feedback truly touched our heart.
